## Entry point

`DeleteMemo` is implemented at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`. Connect/gRPC wrappers delegate to it (`server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:338-343`).

## Call flow (explicit code only)

```
APIV1Service.DeleteMemo
  ├─ for each direct comment memo → Store.DeleteMemo(comment ID)   [567-576]
  └─ Store.DeleteMemo(target memo ID)                              [579-580]
       ├─ Store.DeleteMemoRelation(MemoID)                          [142-143]
       ├─ Store.DeleteMemoRelation(RelatedMemoID)                   [145-146]
       ├─ for each attachment → Store.DeleteAttachment(ID)          [149-156]
       └─ driver.DeleteMemo(ID)                                     [158]
```

Each recursive `Store.DeleteMemo` on a comment memo runs the same cascade.
